description: Declaration of the AdbApiInstance class, which manages device interface instances for Android's ADB API, including reference counting, interface name retrieval, and lifecycle management.

classes.name: AdbApiInstance
classes.description: Represents a device interface instance in the Android ADB API, managing reference counting, interface name, and lifecycle.

methods.name: LastReferenceReleased
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the last reference to the object is released.

methods.name: interface_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the USB interface (device name).

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count and returns the new count.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count, calls cleanup if zero, and returns the new count.

methods.name: IsInitialized
methods.description: Checks if the instance has been initialized with a device interface name.
